title: Wrangler.toml commits stable DO class names on both binding blocks and a migrations tag records the mint classes
asA: operator applying platform-cloudflare-durable-objects on a fresh Workers project
iWant: the generated wrangler.toml to carry [[durable_objects.bindings]] blocks and a paired [[migrations]] block committing the class names under a stable tag
soThat: a future rename lands as a wrangler migration rather than a silent rewire and the DO class identity survives the mint

acceptanceCriteria.description: The fixture wrangler.toml carries at least two [[durable_objects.bindings]] blocks (one binding named CELL with class_name SingleCellObject; one binding named HUB with class_name HubObject) and at least one [[migrations]] block with tag "v1" and new_sqlite_classes = ["SingleCellObject", "HubObject"]. An anatomy assertion greps the toml for each of the four literal strings (name = "CELL", class_name = "SingleCellObject", name = "HUB", class_name = "HubObject") and the tag/new_sqlite_classes pair. A rename in a real project ships as a new migrations tag entry, never a silent edit of the class name.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the anatomy assertion greps for the four literal strings and the migrations pair
acceptanceCriteria.then: every string is present and the migrations tag "v1" carries the two class names

acceptanceCriteria.description: Rename-as-new-migration-tag: a wrangler.toml carrying a second [[migrations]] block with tag="v2" and renamed_classes=[{from:"SingleCellObject", to:"CellObjectV2"}], with the [[durable_objects.bindings]] class_name updated to CellObjectV2, is a valid rename. The anatomy assertion accepts: it greps for tag="v2" and renamed_classes, and asserts the v1 migration still records the original class name for history.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a wrangler.toml with two migrations tags (v1 with new_sqlite_classes, v2 with renamed_classes) and updated binding class_name
acceptanceCriteria.when: the anatomy assertion parses the toml
acceptanceCriteria.then: both tags are present, renamed_classes points from the v1 class to the v2 class, and the binding class_name matches the v2 target

acceptanceCriteria.description: Silent class rename refuses: a wrangler.toml where the [[durable_objects.bindings]] class_name has changed from "SingleCellObject" to "CellObjectV2" but no new [[migrations]] tag records the rename is a defect. The anatomy assertion detects the mismatch (a class named on a binding that does not appear in any migration record) and refuses with DO_MIGRATION_RENAME_UNRECORDED naming the class name.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a wrangler.toml whose binding class_name is not recorded in any migrations tag
acceptanceCriteria.then: the assertion refuses with DO_MIGRATION_RENAME_UNRECORDED naming the class

acceptanceCriteria.description: Missing migrations block: a wrangler.toml with [[durable_objects.bindings]] blocks but no [[migrations]] block refuses at the anatomy assertion with DO_MIGRATION_BLOCK_MISSING; the deploy would fail at Cloudflare mint time (a namespace cannot exist without a migration recording the class).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a wrangler.toml with binding blocks and no migrations block

acceptanceCriteria.description: Stale keyword refuses: a wrangler.toml whose [[migrations]] tag uses new_classes = [...] instead of new_sqlite_classes = [...] refuses at the anatomy assertion with DO_MIGRATION_KEYWORD_STALE naming the deprecated keyword and the vendor URL. Per the cited Cloudflare migrations page, key-value backed namespaces can no longer be created; only new_sqlite_classes mints a fresh namespace.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a wrangler.toml whose migrations tag uses the deprecated new_classes keyword
acceptanceCriteria.then: the assertion refuses with DO_MIGRATION_KEYWORD_STALE naming the vendor page and today's verifiedOn date
